destinations.name: Paris
destinations.description: Paris, France's capital, is a major European city and a global center for art, fashion, gastronomy and culture.

destinations.name: New York
destinations.description: New York City comprises 5 boroughs sitting where the Hudson River meets the Atlantic Ocean.

destinations.name: Tokyo
destinations.description: Tokyo, Japan's busy capital, mixes the ultramodern and the traditional, from neon-lit skyscrapers to historic temples.

destinations.name: London
destinations.description: London, the capital of England and the United Kingdom, is a 21st-century city with history stretching back to Roman times.

destinations.name: Rome
destinations.description: Rome, Italy's capital, is a sprawling, cosmopolitan city with nearly 3,000 years of globally influential art, architecture and culture on display.

destinations.name: Sydney
destinations.description: Sydney, capital of New South Wales and one of Australia's largest cities, is best known for its harbourfront Sydney Opera House.

destinations.name: Dubai
destinations.description: Dubai is a city and emirate in the United Arab Emirates known for luxury shopping, ultramodern architecture and a lively nightlife scene.

destinations.name: Bangkok
destinations.description: Bangkok, Thailand's capital, is a large city known for ornate shrines and vibrant street life.

destinations.name: Singapore
destinations.description: Singapore is a sunny, tropical island in Southeast Asia, off the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula.

destinations.name: Barcelona
destinations.description: Barcelona, the cosmopolitan capital of Spain's Catalonia region, is known for its art and architecture.

destinations.name: Istanbul
destinations.description: Istanbul is a major city in Turkey that straddles Europe and Asia across the Bosphorus Strait.

destinations.name: Hong Kong
destinations.description: Hong Kong is an autonomous territory, and former British colony, in southeastern China.

destinations.name: Mumbai
destinations.description: Mumbai (formerly called Bombay) is a densely populated city on India's west coast.

destinations.name: Rio de Janeiro
destinations.description: Rio de Janeiro is a huge seaside city in Brazil, famed for its Copacabana and Ipanema beaches, Cristo Redentor statue, and Sugarloaf Mountain.

destinations.name: Cape Town
destinations.description: Cape Town is a port city on South Africa's southwest coast, on a peninsula beneath the imposing Table Mountain.

destinations.name: Amsterdam
destinations.description: Amsterdam is the Netherlands' capital, known for its artistic heritage, elaborate canal system and narrow houses.

destinations.name: Berlin
destinations.description: Berlin, Germany's capital, dates to the 13th century. Reminders of the city's turbulent 20th-century history include its Holocaust memorial.

destinations.name: Prague
destinations.description: Prague, capital city of the Czech Republic, is bisected by the Vltava River.

destinations.name: Seoul
destinations.description: Seoul, the capital of South Korea, is a huge metropolis where modern skyscrapers, high-tech subways and pop culture meet Buddhist temples.

destinations.name: Vienna
destinations.description: Vienna, Austria's capital, lies in the country's east on the Danube River.

destinations.name: Marrakesh
destinations.description: Marrakesh, a former imperial city in western Morocco, is a major economic center and home to mosques, palaces and gardens.

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.description: Bali is an Indonesian island known for its forested volcanic mountains, iconic rice paddies, beaches and coral reefs.

destinations.name: Venice
destinations.description: Venice, the capital of northern Italy's Veneto region, is built on more than 100 small islands in a lagoon in the Adriatic Sea.

destinations.name: San Francisco
destinations.description: San Francisco, in northern California, is a hilly city on the tip of a peninsula surrounded by the Pacific Ocean and San Francisco Bay.

destinations.name: Los Angeles
destinations.description: Los Angeles is a sprawling Southern California city and the center of the nation's film and television industry.

destinations.name: Chennai
destinations.description: Chennai, on the Bay of Bengal in eastern India, is the capital of the state of Tamil Nadu.

destinations.name: Delhi
destinations.description: Delhi, India's capital territory, is a massive metropolitan area in the country's north.

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.description: Goa is a state in western India with coastlines stretching along the Arabian Sea.

destinations.name: Kolkata
destinations.description: Kolkata (formerly Calcutta) is the capital of India's West Bengal state.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.description: Jaipur is the capital of India's Rajasthan state. It evokes the royal family that once ruled the region.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.description: Agra is a city on the banks of the Yamuna river in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh, famous for the Taj Mahal.
